key.name: enable-customization
key.description: Adds an edit button to Quick Settings to add and remove toggles.

key.name: removed-toggles
key.summary: Built-in toggles removed from Quick Settings

key.name: added-toggles
key.summary: Extra toggles added to Quick Settings, in order

key.name: toggle-order
key.summary: Order of the Quick Settings toggles
key.description: Toggle ids in the order set in the editor. Toggles not listed go after these.

key.name: small-toggles
key.description: Toggle ids shown as small tiles, half a column wide, with the icon only.

key.name: hide-accessibility-menu
key.summary: Hide the top bar accessibility menu
key.description: The accessibility toggles are available in the Quick Settings editor instead.

key.name: pill-sliders
key.description: Thick sliders with the icon inside the filled part, as in the mockups.

key.name: dnd-menu
key.description: Give the Do Not Disturb toggle a menu to turn it on for an hour, until the evening or until tomorrow.

key.name: dnd-until
key.summary: When Do Not Disturb turns itself off
key.description: Unix time; 0 while it stays on until turned off.

key.name: app-volume
key.description: Adds a slider for each app playing sound to the menu of the volume slider.

key.name: panel-shortcuts
key.description: Middle-click the volume icon to mute, and scroll over the battery icon to change the screen brightness.

key.name: enable-collapsible
key.description: Shows notifications and the media player in Quick Settings. Only one of the two groups is expanded at a time.

key.name: enable-calendar
key.description: A calendar popover without notifications that scales with its content.

key.name: calendar-layout
key.description: "adaptive" adds the date and events column only when there are events; "two-columns" always shows it.

key.name: show-events
key.summary: Show today's events next to the calendar

key.name: enable-widgets
key.description: Replaces the world clocks and weather cards under the calendar with customizable widgets.

key.name: widgets
key.summary: Widgets under the calendar, in order
key.description: Each entry is "id:size", where size is small, medium or large.

key.name: reminders
key.summary: Reminders of the reminders widget, in order
key.description: One JSON object per reminder: {"id", "text", "due" (Unix time, optional), "notified"}.

key.name: stock-symbols
key.summary: Symbols shown by the stocks widget
key.description: Yahoo Finance symbols, e.g. "AAPL", "PETR4.SA", "^BVSP", "BTC-USD". While unset, a default list for the language region is used.
